name: pulse-review-quality-gate
description: Reviews completed React component work in this Laravel Inertia app. Use before finalizing component changes to check requirements, architecture, API, accessibility, design system, Motion, performance, tests, browser behaviour, documentation, and maintainability.
purpose: Catch regressions and missing verification before reporting completion.
single_responsibility: Enforce Gate 2 (Definition of Done) by aggregating domain Completion checklists. It delegates domain checks to their owners rather than redefining them.
triggers: Component implementation or refactor is complete
The user asks for a review
A change touches shared code, interaction, accessibility, media, or performance
outputs: Findings by severity, each naming the owning skill
completion_criteria: Touched concerns are identified from the routing signals
Each touched concern is confirmed against its owner's Completion checklist
Structural Gate 2 items not owned by a single skill are confirmed
Every failed, skipped, or unverifiable item is reported
validation_criteria: No known blocker remains, or it is reported with its owning skill
Final summary is concise and actionable
Review delegates to domain checklists rather than restating them
failure_handling: Do not report completion while a Gate 2 item is unmet; route the unmet item back to its owning skill.
Do not perform large new refactors during review; report them as follow-up instead.
escalation_path: Route unknown framework or library behaviour to pulse-docs-research.
Escalate to the user when a fix requires a scope, dependency, or product decision.
responsibilities: Check design system, Motion, performance, media, tests, and documentation.
non_responsibilities: Performing large new refactors during review.
Redefining domain checks owned by other skills.
